question: ¿Cuántos fármacos aprobados se prueban en ensayos de fase 3 (incluye fase 2/3) tanto de cáncer de mama como de cáncer de pulmón?

attempts.query:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT td.parent_chembl_id, d.label
  FROM aact.studies s
  JOIN linking.trial_condition tc ON tc.nct_id = s.nct_id
  JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
  JOIN mesh.descriptor d ON d.id = a.ancestor_id AND d.label IN ('Breast Neoplasms','Lung Neoplasms')
  JOIN linking.trial_drug td ON td.nct_id = s.nct_id
  JOIN linking.drug dr ON dr.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id AND dr.approved
  WHERE s.phase IN ('PHASE3','PHASE2/PHASE3')
)
SELECT count(*) FROM (
  SELECT parent_chembl_id FROM t GROUP BY parent_chembl_id HAVING count(DISTINCT label) = 2
) x
